blurb: Liberty Mountain Conference Center is Lynchburg’s Premier Conference Center. With over 13,000 square feet of space and more than 8 large event spaces, we can accommodate different size groups. We have state-of-the-art facilities, including hi-speed wireless internet access, reserved parking, complimentary audio visual services, and more.
